title: STILL-PRESENT: W-2 pool-cap clamp — legal caps 1-2 still yield a Pool_Exhaustion crisis that can never resolve
detail: Cap 1: the clamp guards on cap > 1, leaving margin 2 — len+2 < 1 never holds. Cap 2: resolve also needs no drop that tick; a cap-2 pool sheds every admission. Probe: trigger @1200, still active after 3010 ticks post-fix.
recommended_fix: Validate pool_max_packets >= 3 at catalog load (r3's alternative) or make resolve reachable at caps 1-2; add a cap-1/cap-2 resolve-and-recover unit pin.

title: app/main.odin tripwire comment misdescribes the crisis engine's input — no event-buffer scan exists in crisis.odin
evidence:
app/main.odin:120:				// NOTE (4.2 tripwire): the app NEVER drains state.events (the
app/main.odin:121:				// harness drains per tick). The crisis engine's drop scans rely
app/main.odin:122:				// on the buffer being tick-ordered (tail-first with an
app/main.odin:123:				// e.tick < tick break — see crisis.odin) and step now latches
core/crisis.odin:60:	// Input (Perkins r1 W6): the engine reads the flow's per-tick DROP_SITE
core/crisis.odin:61:	// scratch (flow.drop_sites — cleared each tick, appended at each shed), NEVER
core/crisis.odin:193:	// `bundle` this tick? Reads the per-tick DROP_SITE scratch (W6 — the events
detail: The engine reads flow.drop_sites (W6), never the event buffer — no e.tick < tick scan exists in crisis.odin. The comment misleads a maintainer into believing a buffer drain would break crisis triggering.
recommended_fix: Reword: the engine reads the per-tick drop-site scratch; the event-buffer caution applies only to future consumers of state.events.

title: Crisis banner card paints over the tail of the 50-char HUD title (drawn after it, card left edge x=410 at WIN_W 1280)
evidence:
app/main.odin:519:	draw_text(app, "Packet Plumber - v2 story 4.2 (surge + crisis engine)", 12, 10, 22, p.ink)
app/main.odin:560:	rnd.draw_crisis_banner(&app.view, &app.state.crisis, &app.cat, app.state.era)
app/main.odin:23:	WIN_W :: 1280
app/render/crisis.odin:30:	card_w := i32(440)
app/render/crisis.odin:34:	x := (v.win_w - card_w) / 2
app/render/crisis.odin:39:	rl.DrawRectangle(x - pad, y - pad, card_w + 2 * pad, h, card)
detail: The title spans ~750px at 22px from x=12; the card's left edge is (1280-440)/2-10=410, drawn later in the same proc, so its near-opaque background (alpha 240) obscures the title's tail whenever a crisis is active.
recommended_fix: Start the banner below the title line (y >= 40) or draw the HUD title after the banner.
